notes.title: DLC minigame released on schedule
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2336510/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37072064/407417dff9c91626ba7dfe416bbc5bb05b1f4956.jpg[/img]

The DLC minigame has been released as planned.
The game is in Japanese and English only. 
Store pages appear in all languages supported by the base game.
You can select this game when you press "Play" in the Steam app.
Uncheck the DLC checkbox if you do not want this DLC.

Alia fought the enemy in the base game.
However, in this mini-game, Rena(escort target) is unable to fight her enemies and uses recovery magic.
